interface.longDescription: Turn incomplete AI and automation ideas into practical, implementation-ready plans. Agent Router asks focused questions, determines whether AI or an autonomous agent is actually needed, recommends the simplest reliable architecture, defines human approvals, safeguards, source authority, failure handling, and test cases, and explains the result in plain language. It is designed for non-technical and technical users planning assistants, workflows, retrieval systems, or agents. Agent Router is an advisory planning tool: it does not send emails, modify external systems, execute business processes, or make legal, financial, or other high-impact decisions.
defaultPrompt: Help me clarify an AI or automation idea and recommend the simplest reliable approach.
Critique my agent idea and tell me whether I actually need an agent.
Turn my validated idea into an implementation and evaluation plan.

name: agent-router
description: Critically evaluates AI automation ideas, routes them to the simplest robust architecture, and produces implementation-ready specifications and evaluation plans.
